Chat and completion endpoints support streaming responses.

Chat Completions API

The stream field sends partial results using Server-sent events.

Embeddings API

Embedding tasks map input strings into embedding vectors.

Usage

Responses include a usage sub-message which reports the number of tokens in the request and response. The format of this sub-message is the same across all task types.

Field Type Description
completion_tokens Integer Number of generated tokens.
prompt_tokens Integer Number of tokens from the input prompt(s).
total_tokens Integer Number of total tokens.
reasoning_tokens Integer Number of thinking tokens.
cache_read_input_tokens Integer Number of input tokens read from the prompt cache. Returned as a top-level usage field for Databricks-hosted Claude endpoints when caching is active.
cache_creation_input_tokens Integer Number of input tokens written to the prompt cache. Returned as a top-level usage field for Databricks-hosted Claude endpoints when caching is active.

The service tier used for the request. Returns "priority" if priority mode was requested, otherwise "default".
